# Skill — `slot-resume`

> Show a chat slot's MOST-RECENT session entry (and recent history) so you can resume that slot. Use when the user asks "resume slot X", "what was slot X's last session", "pick up where slot X left off"

**Scope:** project

## Description (first paragraph)

**Purpose** (U-SR06, SLOT-RECOVERY-PHASE-A): surface the single most-recent `SlotSessionEntry` for a NATO
slot so a chat can re-enter that slot's work cleanly after a crash, `/compact`, or hand-off. Backed by
`SlotSessionHistoryEngine` (the same per-slot session ledger the crash-detector reads), exposed via the
`prism_session` dispatcher. Deterministic, ~0 Claude tokens.
